name: Stormbrow the Elder
summary: Near Goldshire, Stormbrow the Elder waits beside the water during the Lunar Festival. Travelers honor ancient traditions and the olden races of Azeroth, and receive a token of remembrance in return.

sections.title: A Spirit in Goldshire
sections.body: A quiet pond lies just behind the smithy in Goldshire, where Stormbrow the Elder appears. Guards, tradesfolk, and weary travelers pass through town on their way into the forest. Beneath Elwynn Forest's canopy, the honored spirit welcomes anyone who comes to honor the realm's long history.

sections.title: Honoring the Olden Races
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits of great ancestors return to walk among the living. Stormbrow the Elder commends travelers who remember those who came before. For honoring the wisdom and legacy of the elder peoples, he grants a blessing and a commemorative coin for the season.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: You can find Stormbrow the Elder beside the pond just behind the blacksmith's forge in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.
Stormbrow the Elder is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival and represents the revered elders of Azeroth's olden races.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: Travelers visit Stormbrow the Elder to honor ancient ancestors during the festival. He offers greetings and a token of appreciation in return.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak to Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: The Lunar Festival elders honor all who seek them in peace, but Goldshire is heavily guarded Alliance territory, making a visit perilous for Horde travelers.

faq.q: What token does the Elder offer?
faq.answer: Stormbrow the Elder offers a Coin of Ancestry, a traditional token of respect and remembrance shared by elders throughout the festival.

faq.q: Why does Stormbrow mention the 'olden races'?
faq.answer: Stormbrow commends travelers for remembering that present civilizations walk lands shaped by ancient peoples and enduring customs, long before the modern kingdoms arose.

angles.text: As a human living in Elwynn, you can look to Stormbrow the Elder as a reminder of ancient history beyond Stormwind's walls and its recent wars.
As an Alliance traveler passing through Goldshire, you can find Stormbrow the Elder in the heart of Elwynn Forest, among the most accessible ancestral spirits for young adventurers.
